stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def mark_cc(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or g[i][j]==bg: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; pts=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft(); pts.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and g[nx][ny]!=bg:
                        seen[nx][ny]=True; q.append((nx,ny))
            rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cl=[p[1] for p in pts]
            cols=set(g[x][y] for x,y in pts)
            out.append(dict(color=list(cols)[0],n=len(pts),bbox=(min(rs),min(cl),max(rs),max(cl))))
    return out

def comps_arr(arr,bg):
    H,W=arr.shape; seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if arr[i,j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cs=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and arr[ny,nx]!=bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                res.append(cs)
    return res
def analyze(k):
    I=np.array(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cornercol=[c for c,n in cnts.items() if n==4][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(I.shape[0]) for j in range(I.shape[1]) if I[i,j]==cornercol]
    (r0,r1,c0,c1)=(min(y for y,x in cells),max(y for y,x in cells),min(x for y,x in cells),max(x for y,x in cells))
    sub=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; out=sub.copy()
    inter=comps_arr(sub,bg)
    t=max(inter,key=len); tb=(min(y for y,x in t),max(y for y,x in t),min(x for y,x in t),max(x for y,x in t))
    th=((tb[1]-tb[0]+1),(tb[3]-tb[2]+1))
    print('=== demo',k,'frame',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'template bbox',tb,'thw',th,'n interior comps',len(inter))
    # template colors & other comps info
    for o_ in inter:
        ob=(min(y for y,x in o_),max(y for y,x in o_),min(x for y,x in o_),max(x for y,x in o_))
        cols=sorted(set(I[o_[yy]][o_[xx]] for yy,xx in o_))
        print('   comp bbox',ob,'ncells',len(o_),'colors',cols)

def f_full(k):
    I=np.array(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]

def frames(k):
    I=np.array(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cands=[c for c,n in cnts.items() if n==4]
    best=None
    for cc in cands:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(I.shape[0]) for j in range(I.shape[1]) if I[i,j]==cc]
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        # score by output similarity: crop and compare
        sub=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
        sim=sum(sub!=O[:r1-r0+1,:c1-c0+1])/(sub.size) if sub.size==(O.shape[0]-2*r0+... ) else 0
        return sub,O,bg,cc,(r0,r1,c0,c1),cells
    return None
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    sub,O,bg,cc,fr,cells=frames(k)
    print(k,'frame',fr,'out',O.shape)
    print('crop vs out diff:',sum(sub!=O[:sub.shape[0],:sub.shape[1]]))

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
np.set_printoptions(linewidth=200)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=np.array(G[k+' input']); O=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnts=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc=[c for c,n in cnts.items() if n==4][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(I.shape[0]) for j in range(I.shape[1]) if I[i,j]==cc]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(y for y,x in pts),max(y for y,x in pts),min(x for y,x in pts),max(x for y,x in pts)
    sub=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; oh,ow=O.shape
    # diff mask
    dm=(sub!=O)
    print('===',k,'shape',(th:=sub.shape[0]),tw:=sub.shape[1],'out',(oh,ow))
    if th==oh and tw==ow:
        ddiff=list(zip(*np.where(dm)))
        print('  differing cells:',[(a,b,int(sub[a,b]),int(O[a,b])) for a,b in ddiff][:30])
        # summarize structure: which colors differ
        for c_ in sorted(set(int(sub[a,b]) for a,b in ddiff)|set(int(O[a,b]) for a,b in ddiff)):

            q=[(a,b) for a,b in ddiff if int(O[a,b])==c_]
            print('   sub has',c_,'at',p[:10],'out has',c_,len(q))
    else:
        print('  sizes differ')

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def show(k): return np.array(G[k+' input']),np.array(G[k+' output'])
def f(Gi):
    Gi=np.array(Gi); bg=int(np.bincount(Gi.flat).argmax())
    cands=[]
    for v in np.unique(Gi):
        p=[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(*np.where(Gi==v))]
        if len(p)!=4: continue
        rs={q[0] for q in p}; cs={q[1] for q in p}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            sub=Gi[min(rs):max(rs)+1, min(cs):max(cs)+1]
            m2=(sub!=bg)&(sub!=v)
            lab,ncomp=ndimage.label(m2)
            cands.append((ncomp,h,w,int(v),min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    sel=max(cands,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
    return sel[5],sel[6],sel[7],sel[8],sel[3]
def bbox(p): 
    ys=[q[0] for q in p]; xs=[q[1] for q in p]
    return min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in [1,2,3,4,5]]:
    Gi,Go=show(k)
    i0,i1,j0,j1,c=f(Gi)
    sub=Gi[i0:i1+1,j0:j1+1]
    Go_=np.array(Go)
    oh,ow=Go_.shape
    diff=[(y,x,int(sub[y,x]),int(Go_[y,x])) for y in range(oh) for x in range(ow) if sub[y,x]!=Go_[y,x]]
    # group changes by target color block shape

    # show objects in crop (comps of sub!=bg excluding corner color)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(sub!=bg)

    for cc in range(1,n+1):
        pts=list(zip(*np.where(lab==cc)))
        col=int(sub[pts[0][0],pts[0][1]])
        objs.append({'col':col,'cells':len(pts),'bbox':bbox(pts)})
    print(' objects:',objs)
    # new cells: Go!=sub with sub==bg -> paint area; sub!=bg changed -> recolored / merged
    add=[d for d in diff if d[2]==bg]
    rec=[d for d in diff if d[2]!=bg]
    print(' painted-on-bg cells:',len(add),'recoloring:',len(rec), 'add bbox',bbox([p[0] for p,_ in [(0,d) for d in add]]) if add else None)

import os,glob,re,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Analyze all demos: find frame, objects, added block
def frames(Gi):
    res={}
    for c in np.unique(Gi):
        p=[(y,x) for y,x in zip(*np.where(Gi==c))]
        if len(p)!=4: continue
        rs={q[0] for q in p}; cs={q[1] for q in p}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            i0,i1,j0,j1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            res[(i0,i1,j0,j1)]=(list(rs)[0],list(cs)[0])
    return res
for i in [1,2,3,4,5,6]:
    Gi,Go=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%i]),np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%i])
    fr=frames(Gi)
    # pick frame whose bbox matches out shape
    cands=[k for k,v in fr.items() if (v[1]-v[0]+1)==Go.shape[0] and (v[3]-v[2]+1)==Go.shape[1]]
    i0,i1,j0,j1=list(cands)[0]
    sub=Gi[i0:i1+1,j0:j1+1]
    bg=int(np.bincount(sub.flat).argmax())
    lab,n=ndimage.label(sub!=bg)
    added={(a,b) for a in range(sub.shape[0]) for b in range(sub.shape[1]) if sub[a,b]!=Go[a,b]}
    info=[]
    for cc in range(1,n+1):
        yy,xx=np.where(lab==cc)
        col=int(sub[yy[0],xx[0]])
        s=set(zip(yy.tolist(),xx.tolist()))
        touch=len(added&s)
        # adjacent cells outside object
        ext=any((p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) in added for p in s for dr,dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)])
        info.append((col,len(s),sorted(s)[:1],touch,ext))
    print('===',i,'frame',(i0,i1,j0,j1),'objs:',info)

import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def info(i):
    Gi,Go=np.array(G['Demo pair %d input'%i]),np.array(G['Demo pair %d output'%i])
    v,i0,i1,j0,j1=frame_of(Gi,Go.shape[0],Go.shape[1])
    sub=Gi[i0:i1+1,j0:j1+1]
    bg=int(np.bincount(sub.flat).argmax())
    lab,n=ndimage.label(sub!=bg)
    objs=[]
    for cc_ in range(1,n+1):
        yy,xx=np.where(lab==cc_)
        s=tuple(zip(yy.tolist(),xx.tolist()))
        ys=[yy[0]]; xs=[xx[0]]  # placeholder
        # bounding box
        ys_=min(yy);xs_=min(xx);yh=max(yy)-ys_+1;xw=max(xx)-xs_+1
        cells=set(zip(yy.tolist(),xx.tolist()))
        # find diff region in Go coords mapped back
        tgt={(a,b) for a in range(Go.shape[0]) for b in range(Go.shape[1]) if sub[a,b]!=Go[a,b]}
        objs.append((int(sub[yy[0],xx[0]]),(ys_,xs_,yh,xw),cells,tgt))
    return sub,objs,tgt
sub,objs,tgt=info(1)

from collections import Counter
def analyze(k):
    gi=np.array(G[k+' input']); go=np.array(G[k+' output'])

    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)

        rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cs={p[1] for p in ps}
        return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    best=None
    for v in cands:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=info(v)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)

        print(' cand',v,'bbox',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'area',area,'matches out size:',ok)

    m=best[1]
    ps=[(i,j) for i in range(gi.shape[0]) for j in range(gi.shape[1]) if gi[i][j]==m]

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def analyze(k,verbose=True):
    g=np.array(G[k+' input']); go=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # candidate frame = corner set whose bbox matches output shape
    candsets={}
    for v,n in cnt.items():
        ps=[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j,x in enumerate(g[i]) if x==v]
        rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cc={p[1] for p in ps}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cc)==2:
            candsets[v]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc))
    print('====',k,'shapes{',dict(candsets),'}, out',go.shape)
    for mc,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in candsets.items():
        if (r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)!=go.shape: continue
        sub=g[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; bg=int(sub[0][0])
        dd=[(i,j,int(sub[i][j]),int(go[i][j])) for i in range(sub.shape[0]) for j in range(sub.shape[1]) if sub[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
        # inside comps excluding marker cells
        inc=[]; ooc=[]
        for C in comps(g,bg):
            pts=set(C)
            if any(g[a][b]==mc for a,b in C): continue
            inter=pts & {(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)}
            a0=min(a for a,b in C); b0=min(b for a,b in C)
            label='INS' if inter else 'OUT'
            sh=max(a for a,b in C)-a0+1; sw=max(b for a,b in C)-b0+1
            info=(label,len(C),g[C[0][0]][C[0][1]],(a0-r0,b0-c0),sh,sw)
            (inc if label=='INS' else ooc).append(info)
        print(' marker',mc,'bg',bg,'ndiff',len(dd))
        print('  ins:',inc)
        print('  out:',ooc)
        if verbose:
            print('  additions:')
            for i in range(sub.shape[0]):
                line=''
                for j in range(sub.shape[1]):
                    tag='.' if (i,j) not in {(a,b) for a,b,_,_,_,_ in dd} else ('+' if go[i][j]!=sub[0][0] else '?')
                    line+=tag
                print('   '+''.join(line))
for kk in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    analyze(kk)

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def analyze(gi):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comp = list(map(list(np.where(gi!=bg)), None))
    # components: colors
    H,W=gi.shape
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i,j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=gi[i,j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cs=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and (na,nb) not in seen and gi[na,nb]==c:

import numpy as np, itertools
def analyze2(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    fb=find_frame(gi); r0,r1,c0,c1,mc=fb
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    al=comps_all(gi,bg)
    intr=[o for o in al if r0<=o[1][0][0] and o[1][-1][0]<=r1 and c0<=o[1][0][1] and o[1][-1][1]<=c1 and o[0]!=mc]
    colset=set(gi[a][b] for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1))
    src=[o for o in al if not(r0<=o[1][0][0] and o[1][-1][0]<=r1 and c0<=o[1][0][1] and o[1][-1][1]<=c1) and o[0] not in colset][0]
    # shifted coords: compare output crop to input crop; find shift mapping src->added
    # take crop views
    ic=[[gi[r0+a][c0+b] for b in range(c1-c0+1)] for a in range(r1-r0+1)]
    oc=[[go[a][b] for b in range(c1-c0+1)] for a in range(len(go)-r0+1)] if False else [[go[r0+a][c0+b] for b in range(c1-c0+1)] for a in range(r1-r0+1)]
    # find added cells within crop bbox of added abs
    added=[(a,b,int(oc[a][b])) for a in range(len(oc)) for b in range(len(oc[0])) if oc[a][b]!=ic[a][b]]
    # candidate source positions in output crop: cells with src color not in ic at those spots? find cells colored src in oc vs ic
    srcpos_in_oc={(a,b) for a in range(len(oc)) for b in range(len(oc[0])) if oc[a][b]==src[0]}
    ic_src={(a,b) for a in range(len(ic)) for b in range(len(ic[0])) if ic[a][b]==src[0]}
    print('===',k,'frame',(r0,r1,c0,c1),'bg',bg)
    print(' src:',sorted(src[1]))
    print(' added:',sorted((p[0],p[1]) for p in added))
    print(' src cells in output crop:',sorted(srcpos_in_oc))
    print(' src cells in input crop  :',sorted(ic_src))
    for ob in intr:
        print(' int obj c%d abs %s'%(ob[0],[(a,b) for a,b in ob[1][:5]]),'n=%d'%len(ob[1]))

def frame(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        if c==0: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        minr,maxr,minc,maxc=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # check horizontal top/bottom border rows fully colored, vertical sides too
        if min(H-1,maxr-minr)>=0 and len({i for i in rs})>=2 and len({j for j in cs})>=2:
            okall=True
            for i in [minr,maxr]:
                if not all(g[i][j]==c or g[i][j]==0 for j in range(minc,maxc+1)) or not all(g[i][j]==c for j in range(minc,maxc+1)): pass
            # simpler: full unbroken line of c? require at least corners+continuation
            topok=all(g[minr][j]==c for j in range(minc,maxc+1)) and all(g[maxr][j]==c for j in range(minc,maxc+1))
            leftok=all(g[i][minc]==c for i in range(minr,maxr+1)) and all(g[i][maxc]==c for i in range(minr,maxr+1))
            if topok and leftok:
                best=c,(minr,maxr,minc,maxc)
    return best
